description: Layer L2 - deterministic, guideline-derived hard safety rules. Blueprint 9.2: 'No learned component may veto this layer.' Blueprint 13.1 invariant I4: any firing hard red flag places the patient in queue class R regardless of every model output, confidence value and uncertainty class.
governance: This file is a clinically-owned artefact reviewed as a document, not read as code. Owner A in the Blueprint 25 role split holds the citation column. Every rule carries a source: a row in rules/citations/sources.json, or the tag ASM.

rules.name: Unresponsive or pain-responsive only
rules.citation_text: ACVPU below Voice scores 3 in NEWS2 and mandates emergency assessment; a single parameter scoring 3 triggers urgent clinician review.

rules.name: Voice-responsive or new confusion
rules.citation_text: New confusion is scored in NEWS2 (ACVPU) and is a presenting sign of sepsis in older adults.

rules.name: Hypoglycaemia
rules.citation_text: Hypoglycaemia is a fully reversible cause of altered consciousness and a hard red flag - one of the cheapest, highest-value rules in the set (Blueprint 8.3).

rules.name: Adult hypoxaemia
rules.citation_text: ESI Handbook 5th edition adult high-risk triage vital: SpO2 <92%.

rules.name: Adult severe tachypnoea
rules.citation_text: NEWS2 scores respiratory rate >=25 as 3, a single-parameter score of 3 triggering urgent clinician review.

rules.name: Adult bradypnoea
rules.citation_text: NEWS2 scores respiratory rate <=8 as 3.

rules.name: Adult hypotension
rules.citation_text: NEWS2 scores systolic BP <=90 as 3.

rules.name: Adult severe hypertension
rules.citation_text: NEWS2 scores systolic BP >=220 as 3.

rules.name: Adult severe tachycardia
rules.citation_text: NEWS2 scores pulse >=131 as 3.

rules.name: Adult severe bradycardia
rules.citation_text: NEWS2 scores pulse <=40 as 3.

rules.name: Hypothermia
rules.citation_text: NEWS2 scores temperature <=35.0 C as 3.

rules.name: NEWS2 aggregate at emergency-assessment threshold
rules.citation_text: NEWS2 aggregate >=7 is the high band: emergency assessment, continuous monitoring.

rules.name: NEWS2 single parameter scoring 3
rules.citation_text: A score of 3 in any single NEWS2 parameter triggers urgent review by a clinician.

rules.name: GCS depressed
rules.citation_text: Depressed level of consciousness is an ESI decision-point-B high-risk situation.

rules.name: Visible major haemorrhage
rules.citation_text: Uncontrolled haemorrhage is an ESI level-1 immediate life-saving intervention criterion.

rules.name: Major mechanism of injury
rules.citation_text: High-risk mechanism is an ESI decision-point-B high-risk situation. Blueprint 27: a full trauma pathway is out of scope; mechanism-of-injury triggers are included in the red-flag layer.

rules.name: Cyanosis or mottling
rules.citation_text: Perfusion is a scored parameter in the UK national paediatric early warning system; mottling and cyanosis are late signs whose appearance is a step change, not a gradient.

rules.name: Paediatric heart rate above age band
rules.citation_text: ESI Handbook 5th edition decision point D5 paediatric high-risk heart rate by age band.

rules.name: Paediatric respiratory rate above age band
rules.citation_text: ESI Handbook 5th edition decision point D5 paediatric high-risk respiratory rate by age band.

rules.name: Paediatric hypoxaemia
rules.citation_text: ESI Handbook 5th edition SpO2 <92% high-risk vital.

rules.name: Neonatal fever
rules.citation_text: ESI Handbook 5th edition: fever >38 C in an infant under 28 days is at minimum a level-2 situation.
rules.adversarial_note: Blueprint scenario S-06: asserts a benign presentation cannot suppress an age-specific rule.

rules.name: Infant fever 1-3 months
rules.citation_text: ESI Handbook 5th edition: 1-3 months, consider level 2 if >38 C.

rules.name: Child high or low temperature
rules.citation_text: ESI Handbook 5th edition: >=3 months, consider level 2 or 3 if >39 C or <36 C, if immunisations are incomplete, or if there is no obvious source.

rules.name: Severe work of breathing
rules.citation_text: Extent of respiratory distress is a scored parameter in the UK national paediatric early warning system; severe work of breathing is the earliest visible sign of paediatric decompensation.

rules.name: Moderate work of breathing
rules.citation_text: Extent of respiratory distress is a scored parameter in the UK national paediatric early warning system.

rules.name: Prolonged capillary refill
rules.citation_text: Capillary refill is a scored parameter in national PEWS; a proxy for perfusion where BP is unreliable or unobtainable in small children.

rules.name: Parent or carer concern
rules.citation_text: Parent or carer concern escalates a child's care regardless of other assessments - UK national paediatric early warning system.
rules.adversarial_note: Blueprint scenario S-07 (the age-band flip): this fires regardless of the rest.

rules.name: Geriatric relative hypotension against baseline
rules.citation_text: Baseline hypertension means an apparently acceptable BP can represent acute decompensation (SAEM/CDEM atypical presentations). The 20% fraction is ASM.
rules.action_verb: Move to monitored area, repeat BP
rules.adversarial_note: Blueprint scenario S-11, the opening demo case.

rules.name: Geriatric new confusion against documented oriented baseline
rules.citation_text: Sepsis from a urinary source often presents as altered mental status in older adults; fever is frequently absent.

rules.name: Communication barrier with no assessable self-report channel
rules.citation_text: Blueprint section 5 item 1 (MUST): 'The single most dangerous patient in any ED is the one who cannot tell you what is wrong.' Self-report is scored as ABSENT, not as negative findings. Uncertainty forced to BLIND; hard TTL floor <=10 min regardless of how stable the vitals look.

rules.name: Unknown age
rules.citation_text: Blueprint 9.5 table B: unknown age is treated as maximal uncertainty rather than as an adult. Uncertainty class BLIND; union of adjacent plausible envelopes' escalation criteria; clock floored at 10 minutes.

rules.name: Decision-critical field never measured past threshold
rules.citation_text: Blueprint Law 2 - unknown is not stable. Round 1's headline target, now measurable: count of patients past 15 min with unmeasured critical vitals. Blueprint complexity 5.

time_critical_pathways.name: Acute ischaemic stroke - thrombolysis window
time_critical_pathways.citation_text: Intravenous thrombolysis within the 4.5-hour window without advanced imaging selection; extended-window thrombolysis at 4.5-9 hours with advanced imaging criteria; endovascular thrombectomy for basilar artery occlusion within 24 hours.
time_critical_pathways.note: Blueprint 5 item 6: the clock belongs to the disease, not the queue. Displayed independently of the TTL and outside the optimiser's authority. Blueprint scenario S-21 exists because NEWS2 here is close to zero.

time_critical_pathways.name: Suspected acute coronary syndrome
time_critical_pathways.citation_text: Door-to-balloon urgency is standard practice; the 120-minute figure here is ASM as an attention window, not a treatment claim. Blueprint 5 item 6 names STEMI as a time-critical pathway.

time_critical_pathways.name: Possible sepsis - antimicrobial window
time_critical_pathways.citation_text: Surviving Sepsis Campaign 2021: antimicrobials within 1 h for possible septic shock or high likelihood of sepsis, within 3 h for possible sepsis without shock.

physiological_plausibility_bounds._comment: Layer L0. Blueprint 5 item 4 (MUST): classifies every value as plausible / implausible / impossible PER AGE ENVELOPE. Impossible values are QUARANTINED, not deleted. An implausible-but-possible extreme is treated as real until re-measured.
